title: Planned Theater Site
text: “Iwatani-sama… with that flow, it sounds like I’m the one being kept imprisoned.”
“Isn’t that the dramatic part where you escape the mansion somehow? Seems like something Theo would love.”
“I get that, but… either way, it seems I ended up getting sold off regardless. I’m guessing they claimed I wasn’t actually of the bloodline or something?”
“That’s a possibility too, huh. So, what does the noble who thinks Gaelion-chan is talented actually think?”
“Nano, apparently he’s convinced she strongly resembles his relatives. There’s testimony saying she looks just like them once she grows up, nano.”
“Whoa… a succession dispute? That’s quite the anticipated development, Theo.”
“If it were someone else’s problem, I’d find it exciting, but since I’m the one involved, I’d really rather be spared, Iwatani-sama.”
Father answered rather carefreely, I say.
“So anyway, what about that noble family’s household troubles?”
“After that, there was a mysterious epidemic—suspicious, honestly—that took out people one after another, so the family’s numbers dwindled considerably.”
“Nano, they were shocked to realize this one’s illness had also been cured, nano.”
That would be thanks to me and Rafumi, indeed.
“It’s still just an outline for now. The plan is to stay at that mansion and investigate further in detail. Iwatani-sama, would you come with me?”
“Sure. Since it’s Theo asking. Though after that I’ve got a visit planned to Wolf’s family too, but there’s still some time before that.”
“Thank you very much.”
“I’d like to act separately, so please let Rishia-san investigate together with me. That should be faster.”
Itsuki said something along those lines, I say! Clearly intending to dump everything onto Father, I say!
“Then, let us depart, I say!”
“Please don’t come.”
“Motoyasu-kun’s staying behind on watch duty. Seems like he’d go and kill that noble or something.”
“Eehh! I say!”
I wanted to go too, I say!

“Consider it punishment—or rather, discipline—for Motoyasu-kun. Go calm the waves in other regions, or help Elmelo-san, who’s directing the reconstruction of Eclair-san’s territory. I’ll take you along to Siltvelt later.”
“Guuuh… one must never let their guard down around Rival, I say! Father!”
“Nano, I keep saying it won’t happen, yet it keeps happening, nano.”
“Seems troublesome, so I suppose I’ll keep watch just in case,” Wyndia said.

And so, Father went off with Itsuki regarding Rabbit Guy, leaving me behind, I say! I absolutely hate Shieldfreeden, I say! Though I do know the area well, indeed! It’s the place where I once did idol work with Yuki-chan and the others. I remember Rival smashing up nobles all over that region, indeed.
“Elephant—Father left me behind and told me to help you out, I say! Got anything for me?”
“Uhh……”

I went to ask Elephant, indeed. Éclair and Crocodile Guy were there too. They seemed to be overseeing the town’s reconstruction. Come to think of it, Fiancée still hadn’t arrived. She had things to help with, but how long was she planning to stay at the castle with Filo-tan? Hurry up and come here with Filo-tan already, I say!
“Elmelo, brought the materials!”
Kou was helping Elephant out.
“Thank you very much, Kou-san. Um, could you carry the next batch of materials together with Spear Hero-sama? We’re planning to build the theater right here.”
The fact that the open square near the mansion was becoming a theater differed from the layout in other loops, indeed. Ah, right—this was being built specifically to formally establish a circus.
“Is this gonna be the stage? Elmelo’s gonna sing, right? Sing a little, sing a little!”
“No, that’s… not quite ready yet…”
Just then, the Filolial-samas gathered and turned expectant eyes toward Elephant, indeed. It seemed lunch break was drawing near.
“Well then… shall I sing just a little?”

Since entertainment was deemed necessary, the people helping with construction also gathered, and Elephant’s song was set to be performed, indeed. When the Filolial-samas gathered and sang together happily, some mysterious power would well up inside everyone, so people always came to listen, indeed.
“Ahem… well then, one song to lift everyone’s spirits a little, while we’re on break.”

With that, Elephant cleared his throat and began to sing, indeed. I’d heard it in other loops too, but his voice was still low yet resonant, indeed. What’s more, when the Filolial-samas took his cue and began the chorus, a joyful rhythm spread outward, indeed. Even those not on break kept working to the rhythm of hammering, and the reconstruction progressed as they were drawn in by the singing, indeed. Watching this, Éclair’s eyes seemed to hold a faint trace of frustration.
“I wonder if I should have learned to do something like that as well……”
“Lord Elmelo was raised excelling in both scholarship and martial arts, taught all manner of things, so… I suppose you could call it a difference in environment……”
“From what I’ve heard, he’s the beloved daughter of Lord Janon, a wise general said to rival the Wise King of Knowledge himself… it’s frustrating.”

Crocodile Guy struggled with his words too, indeed. Honestly, Elephant’s abilities were a complete upgrade over Éclair’s in every way, indeed. There was no comparison when it came to governance skill, indeed. In fact, by my own ranking, he was near the top of the list of capable talent, indeed! I’d even say his abilities surpassed Panda’s, indeed!
“Elephant! That was amazing, Elephant!”

Truly a capable talent who got along well with the Filolial-samas, indeed! I could recommend him without hesitation as a suitable match for Father, indeed. I really wish he and Father would get closer, but he’s quite the shy one, indeed! And so, once Elephant finished singing, applause broke out, indeed. This same song had been performed as the closing number back at the circus too. Though, back then in Melromarc, it hadn’t received nearly this much appreciation. Elephant’s operatic vocal style did have its share of quirks, one could say, indeed. According to Father, elephants apparently have a habit of communicating with distant companions using things like footsteps, so it was said that this Elephant’s musical abilities were probably naturally high because of that.
“Ohh, what lovely, cheerful voices.”
Older Sister had arrived, bringing the other Big Sisters along with her, indeed.
“Elmelo-chan, is this the planned theater site?”
“Yes, it is not a tavern.”
“Let’s attach a tavern too, then!”
“If we did that, you’d just move right in and never leave.”
“Of course I would!”
“A theater that permits food and drink… what do you think?”
Elephant asked Éclair, indeed. Passing the buck, one might say.
“Lady Sadeena, this place is not meant to be tavern-oriented. It’s planned as a joyful theater in which Lady Raphtalia and the others can also participate.”
“Ohh, is that so? Understood. Raphtalia-chan and the others must be looking forward to it too.”
“Yeah!”
“This’ll be the perfect chance to show off all our practice!”

Big Sister and Big Sister’s Friend watched the theater under construction with clear anticipation, indeed. Though I must say… Big Sister and the others here were completely childlike, indeed. Nothing like the Big Sister in my memories connects at all, indeed. Well, that can’t be helped, can it! Are you actually targeting that on purpose? To that extent, I have absolutely nothing to do with it! —so the Big Sister in my memories pointed out, indeed. But in this loop, Father doesn’t see Big Sister as a fighting force at all—rather, as a pitiable victim in need of protection, indeed. That’s likely because she doesn’t assert herself. If anything, I feel like Mole occupies a position closer to Father these days. Even so, Big Sister and the others were happily helping with the reconstruction work, and the village was gradually taking shape, indeed. That said, since people weren’t flocking here on account of Father’s fame, the pace itself remained rather slow, indeed. It was only through requesting cooperation from the people of Siltvelt that reconstruction had finally begun moving forward at all, indeed. Anyway, I had been put to work helping with reconstruction under orders from both Father and Elephant, indeed.
“Oh, that reminds me, I heard a rumor! Something about the Heroes, maybe?”
“Did something happen?”
“A traveling merchant mentioned it. Apparently, when bandits attacked a village, someone who sounded like a hero championing justice? showed up and saved them.”
“Wouldn’t that be Sword Hero, perhaps?”
It seemed the story was about one of the split-off Rafumis maintaining public order somewhere, indeed.
